errors.evidence: The description states the data covers the period from 2000 to 2055. However, the data points on the chart only exist from approximately 2011 to 2050. The period from 2000 to 2011 is hallucinated, and the end year is incorrect.
The description claims there is only one line, but the chart and its legend clearly show two lines: a solid blue line with markers and a dotted blue line representing a logarithmic trend.

errors.text_span: В началото, около годината 2000, линията започва от стойност около 14%.
errors.evidence: The chart contains no data points at or around the year 2000. The data starts after 2010 with a value of approximately 7%. This entire statement is fabricated.

errors.text_span: До около 2010 година линията се понижава до стойност около 6%.
errors.evidence: The chart shows no data before approximately 2011, and the entire trend is upward. The description invents a period of decreasing values that does not exist.

errors.text_span: Между 2010 и 2020 година, линията се покачва до стойност около 18%.
errors.evidence: The description overestimates the value in this period. By the end of the data cluster around 2015, the value is approximately 13%, not 18%.
The line ends at the year 2050, not 2055. The final data point is explicitly plotted at the 2050 mark on the x-axis.

errors.text_span: но тъй като е прекъсната и не съдържа точки, не може да бъде описана по-нататък
errors.evidence: This statement is dismissive and unhelpful. It acknowledges the second (dotted) line but refuses to describe it based on the incorrect premise that it lacks points, failing to recognize it as a trendline. This contradicts the earlier incorrect claim that there is only one line.
